verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS financial-infrastructure platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Unit's platform source is public or openly licensed. The linked unit-finance/openapi-unit-sdk repository is an API spec and SDK, not the product's source, and no license is stated for it, so it is at most adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
